text.Audita o raciocínio de atos judiciais. C: Audits the reasoning of judicial rulings. Confronts doubts and returns questions by passage.
text.Criado por <a href=\"https://christianco: Created by Christian da Costa. In personal use since Nov 2025.

text.Procedimento descrito: CERNE 5.1.0. A de: Procedure described: CERNE 5.1.0. The demonstration below replays rounds from version 5.0.0; it does not run a new audit or prove the performance of the current version.
text.Decisão liminar, sentença, voto, acórdão: Interim decision, judgment, opinion, appellate decision
text.Fragilidades encobertas pela fluência do: Weaknesses hidden by the fluency of the text
text.Perguntas por trecho e registro dos afas: Questions by passage and a record of dismissed doubts
text.O objeto é o nexo entre a conclusão e o: The object is the link between the conclusion and what supports it in the ruling: facts, premises, rules, or precedents.
text.A avaliação é humana. Quem responde pelo: The assessment is human. Whoever answers for the ruling decides whether to explain, correct, or keep the position.
text.O ato é segmentado e recebe hash. Onze l: The ruling is segmented and hashed. Eleven lenses and a source-integrity unit form candidates with a passage and verifiable anchors.
text.Cada candidato é sustentado e contestado: Each candidate is argued for and contested independently. The doubt is dismissed or kept as a finding.
text.As dúvidas mantidas viram perguntas por: Upheld doubts become questions by passage, without losing their individual identity or state. Dismissals and arguments stay in the technical record.
text.Escolha um ato. Leia o resumo. Reproduza: Choose a ruling. Read the summary. Replay the round.
text.<i aria-hidden=\"true\"></i>Os estados q: States qualify each doubt, never the ruling. The decision remains human.
text.CERNE 5.0.0: reprodução da rodada de 12/: CERNE 5.0.0: replay of the round of 12 Oct 2026
text.O ato passa por várias lentes, cada uma: The ruling passes through several lenses, each with its own boundary. Every doubt points to a passage that exists in the text.
text.Cada dúvida enfrenta a objeção antes de: Each doubt faces the objection before moving on. Whoever accuses does not judge.
text.O que resiste vira pergunta, presa ao tr: What holds becomes a question, tied to the passage it came from.
text.Perguntas a quem responde pelo ato: Questions for whoever answers for the ruling
text.a dúvida resistiu ao crivo e virou pergu: the doubt withstood screening and became a question, tied to the passage it came from. It calls for reading, explanation, or correction. It is not a veto of the ruling.
text.a dúvida não resistiu ao crivo. Fica reg: the doubt did not withstand screening. It stays on record, with the argument that dismissed it.
text.Achado não mede gravidade nem julga o at: A finding does not measure severity or judge the ruling: it points to a question that needs an answer. CERNE classifies questions, never the ruling.
text.Quem responde pelo ato lê a pergunta, co: Whoever answers for the ruling reads the question, checks the passage, and chooses: explain, correct, research, or keep the position under their own signature. CERNE does not make that choice. It prevents it from going unnoticed.
text.Uma rodada pode terminar sem achados, po: A round may end with no findings, because no doubt formed or because all were dismissed. That is a result, not an endorsement: it does not certify that the ruling is correct.

text.Em <span id=\"pvN2\">9</span> dos <span: In 9 of the 12 rulings in the test, CERNE pointed to an issue that grounded a motion for clarification. In 7, it was the issue the motions later corrected. In 2, it was another issue: in one case the court recognized it in the motions, in the other the party itself raised it.1
text.1 Lote único, <span class=\"pvLote\">TJP: 1 Single batch, TJPR and STJ: 18 rulings selected, 12 in the test. Rulings whose motions recognized only an omission are left out, because CERNE reads only the ruling, and an omission depends on the case file. The two issues outside what the motions corrected were assessed by the author. A result of this selection, not a general precision rate.
text.Do lote ao ponto corrigido: From the batch to the corrected issue
text.A rodada recebe só o acórdão. Os embargo: The round receives only the ruling. The motions come in later, as a reference.
There was oversight. It remains to know of what.
text.Uma ferramenta pesquisa. Outra resume. U: One tool researches. Another summarizes. A third compares. A model formulates the answer. Someone receives the result, reads it, agrees, and moves on.
text.O humano permaneceu no fluxo. Ainda falt: The human stayed in the loop. It remains to know what they did inside it.
text.O Direito governa o raciocínio há muito: Law has governed reasoning for a long time: reasoned decisions, adversarial proceedings, and appeals exist because a conclusion answers for the path that supports it. That control reaches what is made explicit. When systems select, relate, infer, and rewrite, part of the intervention happens before the text.
text.“Governança começa quando o texto deixa: “Governance begins when the text is no longer enough as proof of the path.”
text.Disciplina que estabelece e controla as: A discipline that establishes and controls the conditions under which technologically mediated reasoning is formed when it supports conclusions with legal consequences.
text.Os marcos existentes trabalham com organ: Existing frameworks work with the organization, the system, or the data. Here, the unit is the conclusion with legal consequences and the path that made it possible.
text.Há base verificável, fática e jurídica,: Is there a verifiable factual and legal basis for what was stated?
text.O percurso pode ser reconstruído a parti: Can the path be reconstructed from records?
text.As intervenções relevantes podem ser atr: Can the relevant interventions be attributed?
text.Rastro para saber por onde.<br>Lastro pa:
A trace to know the path.
A grounding to know why.
text.Na versão 5.1.0, onze lentes e uma unida: In version 5.1.0, eleven lenses and a cross-cutting source-use integrity unit examine the same ruling. Each candidate needs a location and valid anchors before confrontation.
The decision on the ruling remains human.
text.A sustentação e a contestação de cada dú: The argument for and against each doubt is produced independently, with no access to each other or to the reasoning of whoever formed the doubt. Quotations from the ruling are checked; external sources are not certified.
text.Quem responde pelo ato recebe perguntas: Whoever answers for the ruling receives questions tied to passages and can confirm, correct, or reject the point raised.
text.Rodadas históricas: perguntas por trecho: Historical rounds: questions by passage, with no decision on the merits.
text.Demonstração CERNE 5.0.0; estes números: CERNE 5.0.0 demonstration; these numbers do not validate version 5.1.0.
text.Human-in-the-Loop ▪ EU AI Act, art. 14 ▪: Human-in-the-Loop ▪ EU AI Act, art. 14 ▪ CNJ Resolution 615/2025 (conceptual correspondence, not certification)
text.O hash vincula a rodada ao ato. O regist: The hash binds the round to the ruling. The record keeps candidates, arguments, quotations, and the reasons for each decision. Grounding supports the doubt; the trace reconstructs its path.
text.Audit Trail ▪ Record-keeping ▪ ISO/IEC 4: Audit Trail ▪ Record-keeping ▪ ISO/IEC 42001 (conceptual correspondence, not certification)
text.Cada dúvida é decidida em separado: afas: Each doubt is decided separately: dismissed when the contestation undoes it, kept as a finding when it holds. States qualify doubts, not the document.
text.Red Teaming ▪ Model Risk Management ▪ Re: Red Teaming ▪ Model Risk Management ▪ Adversarial review (design references)
text.Falha na formação, no tribunal ou na dec: A failure in formation, in the tribunal, or in the decision, after the planned repairs, ends the round with no partial audit. If only condensation fails, individual questions are returned with a warning.
text.Safety by Design ▪ Fail-Safe ▪ Incident: Safety by Design ▪ Fail-Safe ▪ Incident Handling
text.Examina e pergunta; quem responde pelo a: It examines and asks; whoever answers for the ruling decides. The design favors raising doubts for human review.
text.Não atribui nota ao ato. A ponderação da: It does not score the ruling. Weighing the doubts falls to whoever answers for it.
text.Uma rodada sem pergunta é válida e não c: A round with no question is valid and does not certify that the ruling is correct.
text.Falhas de formação, confronto ou decisão: Failures in formation, confrontation, or decision end the round. A failure only in condensation allows individual questions, with a warning.
text.Não verifica existência, vigência ou atu: It does not check whether a rule or case law exists, is in force, or is current. Checking sources falls to whoever cites them.
text.Examina as quatro classes de ato judicia: It examines the four classes of finished judicial rulings. It does not draft conclusions, review style, or validate documents.
text.O texto passa por modelos externos. Cabe: The text goes through external models. The operator must handle confidentiality and personal data; use public or fictitious rulings.
text.Governar um sistema é também fixar o que: Governing a system also means setting what it is not authorized to conclude.
text.Do requisito jurídico ao controle comput: From legal requirement to computational control
text.Núcleo Python/FastAPI, adaptadores separ: Python/FastAPI core, separate adapters, local interface, and SQLite record. Argument and contestation run as independent calls, with the option of models from different families. The technical report preserves every occurrence; the summary and the screen group the questions by passage.
text.Para a versão 5.1.0, o manual registra q: For version 5.1.0, the manual records four real workflow test cases: evidence of technical execution, with no legal performance validated by type of ruling. The historical sample does not measure sensitivity, specificity, or false positives either, nor does it provide a general precision rate.
text.Cada controle executa um requisito: o qu: Each control executes a requirement: what may be produced, under which conditions, and within which limits.

text.Eu confirmo. Tu confirmo. Ele confirmo: Eu confirmo. Tu confirmo. Ele confirmo
text.A verificação que se reduz a gesto sem f: Verification reduced to a gesture with no defined function.
text.Eu guardo. Tu guardas. Ele lembra: Eu guardo. Tu guardas. Ele lembra
text.A memória que decide aquilo que o racioc: The memory that decides what reasoning will be able to see.
text.A fonte que precisa existir e dizer aqui: The source that must exist and say what was attributed to it.
text.Eu escrevo. Tu assina. Ele outorga: Eu escrevo. Tu assina. Ele outorga
text.A formação que desaparece dentro da reda: The formation that disappears inside the drafting.
text.Quem arca com a conclusão também precisa: Whoever bears the conclusion must also be able to give its reasons.
text.Capa indisponível. Abra o artigo no Link: Cover unavailable. Open the article on LinkedIn.

text.O último texto liga a responsabilidade p: The last text links accountability for the conclusion to the duty to answer for its reasons.
text.Eu respondo. Mas adotei o juízo?: I answer. But did I adopt the judgment?
text.A assinatura atribui o ato. Sozinha, não: The signature attributes the ruling. On its own, it does not show that its reasons were adopted. The research Governa-me ou te devoro (Govern me or I devour you), in progress, investigates under which conditions a conclusion formed with AI participation can be attributed, without fiction, to the holder of the authority who should sustain it.
text.Um dispositivo pode exigir resposta. Res: A device can demand an answer. Answering still belongs to whoever decides.
text.Advogado (OAB/PR 89.297), mestre em Dire: Lawyer (Brazilian Bar OAB/PR 89.297), Master of Laws (LL.M., UFPR). Legal Engineering, Legal Operations, and AI governance. Design, canon, architecture, evaluation, and interface of CERNE. Formulation of Legal Reasoning Governance.
text.Em uso próprio desde 11/2025. Versões an: In personal use since Nov 2025. Versions before 5.0 served the work of a judge’s chambers at a TJPR Appellate Panel until May 2026.
text.Antes de delegar o jurídico, é preciso g: Before delegating the legal function, one must govern its reasoning.
